specs.title: an approved column full of unassigned work is left alone
a task the owner assigned to themselves is taken, and stays assigned to them
a task assigned to somebody else is not taken

unassigned work in the column does not hide the one task that was handed over
a task assigned to the machine's own identity is not taken
claims nothing for a machine whose owner is unset

is not adopted by a third writer that merely echoes its assignee

the unblocked sibling behind it is claimed instead
finishing the blocker makes the task claimable
